item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Pod-Level Resource Managers graduated to Beta
item.description: With the release of Kubernetes v1.37, the Pod-Level Resource Managers feature has graduated to Beta status (disabled by default)! (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Lyft Moves Streaming Fleet to Apache Flink Kubernetes Operator
item.description: Lyft has moved hundreds of production Flink jobs from a 2020 in-house Kubernetes operator to the Apache Flink Kubernetes Operator, unlocking last-state upgrades, in-place autoscaling and resource autotuning across the fleet. (1 source: infoq)
